name: docs
description: Docs is an open-source text editor: web-native, made for real-time collaboration, cleanly structured documents and sub-documents with full ownership of your data. Built to scale with Django and React.

latest_release.name: v6.1.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

## 📢 New - Mention members !
From comments or directly from the editor.

[mention-in-comments.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f7622992-3017-4791-b5e4-d1b73a751fc4)





### Added

- ✨(frontend) mention users in the editor from the "@" dropdown by @AntoLC #2806
- ✨(backend) add a dedicated document abilities endpoint by @RoeeSivan #2885
- ✨(frontend) scroll smoothly to a block linked from the same doc by @AntoLC #2932
- ✨(frontend) add a /children block listing the sub-docs by @MashdorDev #2799
- ✨(frontend) mention users in the comments by @AntoLC #2326
- 🤖(agents) add AI skills by @AntoLC #2746
- ✨(frontend) better interlink anchor on same document by @AntoLC #2932
- ✨(frontend) show "no access" in a link to a doc without access by @AntoLC #2932

### Changed

- 💄(frontend) restore native task checkboxes and dim completed tasks by @Manixhor #2857
- ⬆️(frontend) upgrade BlockNote to 0.56.0 by @AntoLC #2936
- ⬆️(frontend) upgrade BlockNote to 0.57.0 by @AntoLC #2964
- ♻️(frontend) replace emoji-mart with the Frimousse emoji picker by @AntoLC #2964
- ♻️(frontend) export PDFs with the Typst engine by @AntoLC #2936
- ⚡️(yhub) read the abilities from the dedicated backend endpoint by @RoeeSivan #2922
- ⚡️(frontend) reuse the cached titles of the interlinks on export by @MashdorDev #2799
- ♻️(backend) remove the unused scope of the document throttles by @RoeeSivan #2951
- 💄(frontend) use true italic Inter in the editor by @harsh472000 #2861
- 🔒️(yhub) build the production image on a distroless base image by @lunika #2985
- 👷(ci) scan images with trivy only on release/ branches or the trivy label by @lunika #2984
- 💄(frontend) redesign 500 error standalone page by @Ovgodd #2801

### Fixed

- 🐛(frontend) no offline banner when a third-party POST fails by @AntoLC #2939
- 🐛(frontend) replace an image that cannot be exported by a message by @AntoLC #2936
- 🐛(frontend) fix the slides pdf export of docs with interlinks by @MannXo #2928
- 🐛(frontend) reload on a version mismatch only when frontend behind by @AntoLC #2940
- 🐛(frontend) hide source popup in read-only mode by @atharvasalunke1267 #2908
- 🐛(frontend) duplicate the sub-docs created without reloading the page by @AntoLC #2915
- 🐛(frontend) show the doc tree actions of the item under the pointer by @AntoLC #2942
- 🐛(frontend) only index the landing page, send noindex as a header by @AntoLC #2973
- 🐛(frontend) keep the focus on the emoji button of a tree item by @AntoLC #2964
- 🐛(backend) keep the case of titles and names in email subjects by @RoeeSivan #2792
- 📝(docs) recreate the containers when upgrading a compose install by @lunika #2985
- 🐛(frontend) fix Enter and Space in modals opened from the doc tree by @Ovgodd #2879

### Removed

- 🔥(backend) remove easy-thumbnails and Pillow by @RoeeSivan #2909

## New Contributors
* @atharvasalunke1267 made their first contribution in https://github.com/suitenumerique/docs/pull/2908

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/suitenumerique/docs/compare/v6.0.4...v6.1.0
